scope: Three frozen dense-table questions × two modes on one freshly ingested PDF; no release or merge authorization.
reviewer: Independent Codex model reviews under the frozen protocol; no human review or paid judge.
metric_definition: Complete 20-metric inventory for each arm and all requests, with preparation separately scoped. Candidate retrieval, structural supplied coverage, and semantic answer review remain distinct.

Final evidence coverage.method: Frozen 0/0.5/1 protocol; independent Codex model review against original-page facts and actual supplied context. Blank contents require explicit row, empty positions, parent and leaf headers. An honest context limitation can be faithful but incomplete.

structural_diagnostic.method: Actual source/supplement slices, exact table-cell tuples, row labels, full header paths and report-period cells. Blank targets additionally require a complete supplied original row. Separate from semantic model review.

Answer correctness.method: Frozen 0/0.5/1 protocol; independent Codex model review against original-page facts and actual supplied context. Blank contents require explicit row, empty positions, parent and leaf headers. An honest context limitation can be faithful but incomplete.

appropriate.reason: No fully unanswerable questions in this workload.

Abstention.method: Full refusals only. Point-level uncertainty is separately reviewed, and printed blanks are answerable cell contents. Errors are not abstentions.

First-answer-delta latency.population: Completed SSE requests in this subset
First-answer-delta latency.method: Client perf_counter from HTTP start to first nonempty answer delta / stream closure. Startup excluded; request and provider/network waits included. These boundaries are distinct.

unsuccessful_requests.method: Failed/incomplete timings remain separate. Missing first deltas are not replaced by response completion time.

First-answer-delta latency.response_path_caveat: Scope rejections and programmatic replies can complete without answer generation. Do not interpret the mixed aggregate as normal generation performance.

unsuccessful_requests.method: Failed/incomplete timings remain separate. Missing first deltas are not replaced by response completion time.

historical_matched_case.limitations: Only dense-table has the same historical question and expected facts. The new run uses a fresh single-PDF library and a later product version with intervening retrieval/citation changes. Disclose those differences; do not attribute all changes causally to the parser or invent a baseline for the two new questions.
historical_matched_case.method: Historical requested-point scores retained verbatim; new independently reviewed points shown alongside them. Different corpus/index and intervening product changes prevent causal parser-only attribution or a common six-request baseline.

validity.annotation_limit: Three reused development rows from one original page, not a held-out or exhaustive table benchmark. No correctness claim for unannotated rows, footer totals, OCR, chart/figure understanding or formulas.
validity.latency_limit: One stochastic pass with three samples per arm; shared sequential process, provider/network waiting, caching and lazy model loading prevent causal performance attribution.
validity.historical_records: Read-only comparison; prior questions, scores and artifacts were not changed.

evaluator_attempts.correction: The initial single-mode scope rejection was treated as an empty executed query. The final diagnostics exclude it from per-query stage means while retaining zero final selected-fact coverage; both artifacts and command records remain.
